scope: Local exact namesake follow-up, 2 February–1 May 2028 inclusive, LV/LT/EE. Three-month namesake pass; name histories are unchanged.

people.method: Reconciled all under-five profiles with the completed national exact-title discovery and country/prominence outcomes from rounds 117–128. No broad Wikipedia or Wikidata query was repeated. Searched 170 selected exact name strings using the private source-cache CLI, inspected cached professional source text and followed selected institutional leads. New pages were downloaded with the official source-cache tool; productive existing pages were reused. Accepted exact first names, roles and separate country associations were read in opened source text. URLs remain in working files/provenance, never widget citations.
